summary: Specifies version 7 of the Bundle Protocol for delay-tolerant networking, adapted from the experimental protocol in RFC 5050. It is designed for networks where connections can be long delayed or intermittent, such as in space. Data travels as bundles that are stored and forwarded when links become available. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Messages wait at each stop until the next road opens, like passing a parcel across a place with no steady roads.
